about: Send effect ids on the Modwerk Analog Rytm MKII base. Each send effect module's record (struct mw_fx, include/modwerk/fx.h) carries its id, 1 to 63, and a kit saves the chosen effect by that id, so an id is never reused or renumbered. npm run modules:check refuses a module whose record carries another id than its entry here. Take the next free number.
